g.text: Template Method: this guide's own case-study format
Same 5 steps, same order, every time -- only what fills each step changes. You're reading a live instance of it.
Payments System fills it in as...
Job Scheduler fills it in as...
Record intent before calling the processor
The order and the count of steps never change -- every case study in this guide is required to fill in the same
five blanks. A fixed skeleton with swappable steps IS Template Method, applied to how this guide is written.
